title: Accessibility fixes on the sheet, shops, Market and chat
summary: Screen readers, keyboards and low-vision players get correctly announced sheet tabs, named pickers, readable gain and loss colours, and a focusable chat history.
items: Character sheet tabs announce as tabs with the selected one marked; arrow keys move between them.
The shop's "Sell to this shop" picker is named "Item to sell", and Market quotes read out the good, exchange, prices and change.
Gains, losses and "Open for trading" use darker or lighter shades in every theme so they meet 4.5:1 contrast.
The chat history and the shop's inventory totals can be reached and scrolled with the keyboard; new messages are announced.
The fairness "New" badge is readable in the dark theme, and links inside sentences are underlined.
